title: Complete pro-etale proper base change
statement:
Let $A$ and $I$ satisfy the adic coefficient datum, let $f:X\to Y$ be
proper, and let $g:Y'\to Y$ be arbitrary. Suppose $K\in D(X_{\Proet},A)$ is
derived $I$-complete and, for every $n$, $K_n$ is equipped with an
etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]
$$
 L_n\in\Dplus(X_{\Et},P_n),
 \qquad \nu_X^*L_n\xrightarrow{\sim}K_n,
$$
compatible with transition maps. Then
$$
 \Ex^{\mathrm{comp}}_{\square,K}:
 Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*K
 \xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*Lg'^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K
$$
is an isomorphism.

note:
*Source note:* for proper base change on the pro-etale site, see Stacks
Project, Pro-etale Cohomology, Section 61.30
([Tag 09C8](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C8)). This statement is
Theorem 61.30.1 there
([Tag 09C9](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C9)): for $f:X\to Y$
proper, a Noetherian ring $\Lambda$ with an ideal $I$ such that $\Lambda/I$
is torsion, and $K\in D(X_{\Proet})$ derived complete with
$K\otimes^L_\Lambda\underline{\Lambda/I^n}$ bounded below with cohomology
sheaves coming from $X_{\Et}$ and $\Lambda/I^n$ a perfect $\Lambda$-module,
the base change map $Lg^*_{comp}Rf_*K\to Rf'_*L(g')^*_{comp}K$ is an
isomorphism. Hypothesis comparison: the blueprint's etale-origin witness is
exactly Stacks' condition that $K\otimes^L_\Lambda\underline{\Lambda/I^n}$
be bounded below and of etale origin, and the perfectness of $P_n=A/I^n$ is
required in the adic coefficient datum; what the blueprint adds is the
tower-level form, in which the witnesses are required to be compatible over
$n$ and the completed pullback is the one defined in
[def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] from Lemma 61.20.2 ([Tag
099N](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/099N)), the proof running through
the finite-level rectangle and the completed-map reduction rather than
through Stacks' reduction to etale cohomology.

proof.text: The adic datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] requires each $P_n=A/I^n$ to be finite and perfect. For each $n$ the given witness has $L_n\in D^+(X_{\Et},P_n)$ and $\nu_X^*L_n\simeq K_n$. Apply [thm-weil-pbc-finite-level-proetale] with $\Lambda=P_n$ and this witness. Since $f$ is proper, every finite exchange $v'_n=\Ex_{\square,K_n}$ is an isomorphism.

By [def-weil-pbc-four-arrows], $v'_n:B_n\to D_n$ is exactly the finite-level pro-etale exchange for $K_n$ with its specified witness, hence is invertible by step 1. By [lem-weil-pbc-tower-compatibility], these arrows assemble into a morphism $v'_\bullet$ in $D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(Y'))$ whose evaluation at $n$ is $v'_n$. All hypotheses of the four-corner construction hold: the square is cartesian, $f$ is proper and $K$ is derived complete. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-levelwise-isomorphism-cones] to obtain that $v'_\bullet$ and $\Rlim(v'_\bullet)$ are isomorphisms. By [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map], the latter is the middle arrow of the specified ordered composite.

The outer arrows of [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map] are the specified reconstruction/projection-formula isomorphism and the inverse direct-image/derived-limit comparison. [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits] states that the latter comparison is an isomorphism. Hence the three arrows are invertible. Compose their inverses in reverse order; cancellation proves both inverse identities for the specified completed exchange. [lemma-weil-pbc-completed-map-reduction] also identifies reductions of this very map with the finite exchange maps; this is a statement about the completed map, not an identification of tower evaluations.
The supplementary naturality, identity-square and horizontal and vertical pasting assertions in the final sentence of the blueprint proof follow from [lemma-weil-pbc-completed-exchange-coherence].
